note: Real Israeli chess professionals. 'rating' is the offline fallback FIDE standard rating; the app refreshes live ratings from THREE real sources — FIDE (via the public Lichess FIDE database API), the Israeli Chess Federation chess.org.il (by 'ilId'), and chess.com's public API (by 'chessComUser'). 'fideId' and 'ilId' are verified where set; ilId=0 or empty chessComUser simply skips that source for that player. Edit freely.
